recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13125 unless future build tooling drops the equivalent summary/min consistency validation.
issue_request: FHIR-13125 asked to correct required elements whose parents were included in summaries but whose own isSummary flag was missing, originally naming CapabilityStatement/Conformance, Consent, Encounter, and Observation elements. Its final Published/Persuasive resolution says a minOccurs=1 element with isSummary parents should also be isSummary and that this should be an error.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in git-svn commit 0ad99fb844c59d64bf782e85eec2e491813f84c5, '#13125 - apply rules about isSummary consistency'. That commit changed the then-current resource spreadsheet inputs, made CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.interaction optional for summary responses, added summary flags to required summary descendants such as CapabilityStatement.messaging.event.mode/focus, CapabilityStatement.document.mode, and Encounter.diagnosis.condition, and added a ResourceValidator error for required elements under summary parents.
additional_context: FHIR-13124 is the same change family and supplied the companion rule that descendant elements should not be marked summary when their parent is not summary. In current source, the affected resources remain active in source/fhir.ini, but several historical paths have been renamed or remodeled: CapabilityStatement.messaging.event is now messaging.supportedMessage, Consent actor/except actor content is now provision.actor and not summary, Observation.related.target is now hasMember/derivedFrom, and Questionnaire.item.enableWhen remains outside summary because Questionnaire.item is not summary.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. Current target checks show the named or successor elements are either already summary where required, optional, no longer under a summary parent, or no longer present in the current model. A scan of all 132 active resource StructureDefinition XML files found zero min>0 elements lacking isSummary while their immediate parent isSummary.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published/Persuasive issue for removing isSummary from Questionnaire.item descendants when Questionnaire.item itself was not in the summary; it explains the parallel ancestor-summary rule cited in the seed comments.
